title: nan
authors: Barzegar A.; Doukhi O.; Lee D.-J.
key_contribution: Presents an autonomous electric ground vehicle fusing Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) with wheel odometry via EKF and using NMPC path tracking in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
